description: This file is a CMake script designed to find and configure the Broadcom Nexus (NXCLIENT) library within a software project. It attempts to locate the Nexus client headers and library files, sets variables indicating whether the library was found, and defines an imported library target for use in build configurations.

methods.name: find_path
methods.description: Searches for the specified header file 'nexus_config.h' in the given path suffixes.

methods.name: find_library
methods.description: Locates the 'nxclient' library binary on the system.

methods.name: include
methods.description: Includes CMake modules or scripts, such as 'FindPackageHandleStandardArgs'.

methods.name: find_package_handle_standard_args
methods.description: Handles standard package finding routines, setting the _FOUND variable appropriately.

methods.name: mark_as_advanced
methods.description: Marks variables as advanced to hide them from normal CMake UI unless explicitly shown.

methods.name: add_library
methods.description: Defines an imported library target for NXCLIENT.

methods.name: set_target_properties
methods.description: Sets properties for the imported library target, including interface languages, location, and include directories.

methods.name: message
methods.description: Outputs status or error messages during the configuration process.
